source.name: OpenStreetMap coastline water and land polygons

inlandWaterLayer.policy: Audit separately; coastline water-polygons do not cover ordinary lakes/reservoirs. Classify the Caspian exception and other proven closed water components explicitly; unresolved cases stay unknown.
inlandWaterLayer.landCertificationPolicy: Coastline land-polygons establish non-ocean only. Where inland-water coverage/validity is unaudited, retain unknown with inland-unresolved; a missing layer, unloaded tile or absence of features is not proof of land or a homogeneous land parent/constant. Only audited land evidence can certify class 2; independently verified ocean remains usable.

source.runtimeAccess: distributed derived assets only; never query OSM editing/API/production services for live classification

oceanConnectivity.method: normalize split/overlap boundaries and holes, then audit vector connected components
oceanConnectivity.caspianPolicy: explicitly exclude from ocean after source topology/semantics audit
oceanConnectivity.otherClosedComponents: inland-water only when verified; otherwise unknown

classification.footprintRule: Require one verified class over the entire texel footprint; detect shore crossings and small rings/islands wholly inside it. Centre/four-corner tests alone are insufficient.
classification.internalCuts: same-class splits, overlaps, date-line and pole cuts are not semantic shorelines
classification.waterMaskRole: auxiliary inside already verified ocean only
classification.elevationRole: never infer ocean from negative height or imagery colour

grid.poleRule: audited longitude-independent cap semantics; artificial cuts do not create coasts

planned.format: headerless uint8 categorical R8; one byte per texel
planned.sampling: exact categorical/nearest; no linear interpolation or averaged mipmaps
planned.sparseRefinement: refine audited shoreline regions; never materialize all global highest-level tiles
planned.constantRule: represent an entire region as a constant only after full-footprint proof from the audited source
planned.parentRule: same snapshot/build, conservative full-footprint classification; complete homogeneous certified child footprints may be aggregated, never averaged
planned.metadataRule: Record actual availability, source/build identity and a recoverable reason for each unknown texel. Freeze sidecar/index encoding with real O0-R02 prototypes.
planned.prototypeGate: O0-R02 evidence is not automatically a published global runtime asset

priority: already-valid data for the same geographic tile in the active source/build
published verified conservative parent in the same source/build
unknown: retain existing terrain/imagery and suppress ocean draw
fallback.missingSourceBuild: fail generation and report missing inputs; never publish a fabricated or empty successful mask

budgets.scope: all coverage levels combined, including real resident parents
budgets.otherResources: CPU decode, pending requests and metadata need separate bounded budgets at implementation; constants do not imply resident descendants

limitations: Candidate URLs are acquisition plans, not downloaded or hash-verified source snapshots.
The raw OSM Alcatraz API sample supports one source-detail comparison only; it does not validate the published global package, raster hierarchy or GPU output.
OSM vector detail has no uniform metre resolution or guaranteed global positional error bound.
MHWS is a static coastline reference, not instantaneous tide or mean sea-level height.
No bathymetry, vertical datum conversion, potential tidal connectivity or sea-ice simulation is provided; O5 retains those data responsibilities.
Classification never authorizes removal of arbitrary terrain/islands; the bounded identified ocean-lid policy still applies.
